entries.title: Bring Back The Oldies
changes: Added a special new map with its own unique presentation and features.
Added new special options to the Settings menu for additional customization.
Fixed White and Gold moves with equal final damage not activating their effects correctly.
Fixed Sacred Fire not correctly burning the battle opponent.
Fixed certain move-effect indicators not displaying correctly in figure previews.
Various additional UI improvements and fixes based on recently reported issues.
Fixed excessive empty spacing in the Plate Library preview panel.
Added streamer mode in settings. Hides the team name when searching in online matchmaking.
Various additional bug fixes and UI improvements.
Fixed Android crash when changing the menu music.
